check_box.label: AO
check_box.name: ao_enabled
check_box.tool_tip: Turn the animation overrider on or off (/ao on, /ao off)

button.name: edit_btn
button.tool_tip: Open the AO editor: sets, states, animations, import

button.name: prev_btn
button.tool_tip: Previous stand (or previous animation of the current state)

check_box.label: Override sits
check_box.name: sit_override
check_box.tool_tip: Replace sit animations with this set's. Seats with their own animation still win when Smart sit is on (/ao sit)

button.label: Pause
button.name: pause_btn
button.tool_tip: Pause or resume the AO without switching it off (/ao pause, /ao resume)

check_box.label: Walk backwards facing forward
check_box.name: back_facing_check
check_box.tool_tip: On: moving backwards keeps your avatar facing forward and the AO plays its Walking Backwards animation (running: only in your own view). Off: your avatar turns round to face where it is going, walking or running, and the AO plays its forward Walking animation. Works with the AO off (then Off leaves the viewer default).

check_box.label: Allow swimming
check_box.name: swim_check
check_box.tool_tip: In deep water float at the surface, dive with crouch (C / Page Down), rise back when released, swim up with E / Page Up, and walk out onto land. Uses flying, so not where flying is blocked. Works with the AO off, but the swim animations come from the AO set.

button.label: Don't pause for this
button.name: ignore_btn
button.tool_tip: This animation does not fight the AO (a deformer, a body fix, a small pose): never pause for it again. Manage the list in the AO editor.

button.label: Resume my AO
button.name: resume_scripted_btn
button.tool_tip: Run this AO alongside the scripted AO you are wearing. Remembered choices can be changed under Remembered choices in the AO editor.
